purpose: Capture failure details visible in worker chat finals that may be absent or coarser in durable RUN status. Summaries only; no raw private transcript bodies are published.
evidence_boundary: Compiled by the Guide from recent worker-chat visible final outputs plus durable GitHub refs. Chat-visible summaries are candidate evidence until reconciled with exact durable artifacts. Never use this file as execution authority.

observed_failure_classes.lesson: A worker that produced the workload but cannot persist RETURN is not equivalent to a worker that failed the workload. Preserve local-complete/durable-incomplete distinction.

next_experiment_implications: MAXCAP analysis must exclude pre-authority E2 failures from local-work quality denominators while still reporting admission rate.
Persist last_completed_block/task and local_work_complete separately from durable_receipt_persisted.
Treat cross-slot reads before CLOSE as automatic contamination.
Do not ask workers to inspect peers; use a separate analyzer after the frozen cohort.
Require a compact visible hard-stop diagnostic only when a genuine tool/security/transport denial prevents the next mandatory durable action.
Continue using external durable clocks for timing; chat-visible reasons explain failure class, not elapsed time.
